Jo (People Ops): quick check  Tori enrolled for 401k catch-up yesterday but payroll shows deductions back to Feb. Can payroll confirm and advise fix?

Sam (Payroll): looking. Tori, did you put an effective date on the enrollment?

Tori (Engineer): I left it as 'effective immediately' on 2024-08-01 only. Didn't expect earlier months.

Sam (Payroll): vendor mapped the election start as 2024-01-01 for some reason I'll open a ticket with Fidelity and prep a correction batch. Preferred flow is recordkeeper return-of-excess so it's not taxable to employee.

Jo (People Ops): vendor is Fidelity for Tori. Tori, can you DM paystub screenshots?

Tori (Engineer): Sent.

vendor-bot: Ticket #9901 created with Fidelity. ETA 2 business days.

Sam (Payroll): Plan: 1) ask Fidelity to accept excess return, 2) if accepted we'll reverse payroll deferrals and create plan adjustment, 3) if not, process corrective distribution and notify Tori about tax docs. I'll update when we hear back.

Jo (People Ops): thanks. Also adding a one-line SOP note: set vendor effective date to next pay period to avoid backfill. Sam can you add?

Sam (Payroll): will add to SOP and integration tests. :thumbsup:
